light_setup: 420 nm LED array surrounding reactor coil

streams.pump_role: Liquid feed containing substrate and photocatalyst
streams.reasoning: Chemistry Plan stream_logic dictates single liquid stream. Flow rate derived from residence time calculation (0.3 min) and reactor volume (1.11 mL).
Chemistry Plan identifies O2 as reagent. Engineering calculation specifies 5.34 sccm air MFC to meet stoichiometric demand and mass transfer requirements.

mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan states all components can be mixed prior to irradiation. Gas-liquid mixing required for O2 transfer.
pre_reactor_steps: Dissolve Fmoc-L-methionine and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole in acetonitrile to 0.1 M.
Pressurize air line with MFC set to 5.34 sccm.
chemistry_notes: Photo-oxidation of methionine to sulfoxide. Oxygen is a reactant; deoxygenation is prohibited. Reaction is mass-transfer limited (Da >> 1), requiring efficient gas-liquid mixing. Short residence time (0.3 min) enabled by high photon flux in flow. BPR required to maintain O2 solubility (Henry's Law) and prevent gas expansion.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation Step 2: 0.3 min based on 15x intensification factor from batch 5 min. Analogy 2 used 16 min but had poor mass transfer; our design uses pressurized air to enable shorter time.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Gas-liquid system. Using inlet/STP basis as per universal physics rules for gas-liquid feeds. In-channel time is lower due to pressure compression of gas.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Batch condition 21 C. No thermal advantage needed. Analogy 1 used 200 C for thermal cascade, not applicable here.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8: 3.0 bar required for gas-liquid system to maintain O2 solubility and prevent degassing. Analogy 2 used 10 bar, but 3 bar is sufficient for MeCN at 21 C.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: FEP preferred for photochemistry (transparent to 420 nm). Analogy 3 used FEP. Analogy 1 used steel (opaque) but had external light source; FEP allows direct irradiation.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Batch condition 0.1 M. Analogy 1 used 0.5 M, but solubility of Fmoc-Met may limit higher concentrations. Maintaining 0.1 M ensures solubility and matches batch kinetics.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculation Step 3: 1.11 mL derived from V = t * Q = 0.3 min * 0.5 mL/min. Analogy 2 used 4.6 mL but with longer residence time.
reasoning_per_field.wavelength_nm: Chemistry Plan: 420 nm matches photocatalyst absorption. Analogy 1 used 455 nm, Analogy 3 used 440 nm; 420 nm is specific to this catalyst.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Derived from residence time and volume. 0.5 mL/min provides reasonable throughput while maintaining laminar flow (Re=22.5).
